formal_statement: ∀ p : Polynomial ℕ, ∃ (n : ℕ) (F : Finset (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin n))), (∀ C ∈ F, C.card ≤ 3) ∧ ¬ PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfiable (↑F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin n))) ∧ ∀ π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinClause (Fin n)), PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsLinRefutation (↑F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin n))) π → p.eval n < π.length
plain_statement: For every polynomial p there is an unsatisfiable CNF on n variables with every clause of at most 3 literals whose dag-like Res(+) refutations (resolution over linear equations mod 2, semantic weakening) all have more than p(n) lines. Family: pigeonhole on the bounded-degree expander of L-pcx-043, turned into a 3-CNF with extension variables; degree bound from L-pcx-046 (open), size from L-pcx-042. Claimed in unrefereed 2026 preprints only (arXiv:2610.00837); with L-pcx-018 it refutes L-alg-003.
title: TARGET: some unsatisfiable 3-CNFs have no polynomially bounded dag-like Res(+) refutations
